name: Shepherd's headband
description: Keeps the sun out of your eyes.

name: Shepherd's tunic
description: Dress like a shepherd from Bethlehem.

name: Round Up
description: Drive the scattered flock back into the fold.

name: Verse Builder
description: Put the words of a verse back in order.

name: Shepherd's bag
description: A pouch for carrying stones.

name: Harp Song
description: Play the harp the way David did for the king.

name: Shepherd's harp
description: For songs out in the fields.

name: Young goat
description: Shepherds kept goats too. This one is nosy.

name: Donkey
description: Strong, patient, and never in a hurry.

name: Stone Search
description: Find five smooth stones as fast as you can.

name: Lamb
description: It followed David from Bethlehem. Now it follows you.

name: Head cloth
description: For long days out in the hills.

name: One Stone
description: David needed one stone. How many will you need?

name: Shepherd's staff
description: Every shepherd carries one.

name: Feast-day tunic
description: Clean and white, for a day of sacrifice.

name: Jonathan's bow
description: A gift between friends.

name: Arrow Signal
description: Land three arrows just beyond the boy.

name: Soldier's tunic
description: Dress like a soldier of Israel.

name: Wild goat kid
description: It came down from the Rocks of the Wild Goats.

name: Calf
description: Curious, and always hungry.

name: The king's helmet
description: Still far too big.

name: Royal cloak
description: Deep red and gold, fit for a coronation.

name: Two by Two
description: Find the pairs of animals, the way they came to the ark.

name: Dove
description: A dove like the one that brought Noah the olive leaf.

name: Traveler's robe
description: For a long walk to a land you have never seen.

name: Water jar
description: Like the one Rebekah carried on her shoulder.

name: Camel Water
description: Water all ten of Rebekah's camels, as fast as you can.

name: Young camel
description: It drank its fill at Rebekah's well. Now it follows you everywhere.

name: Coat of many colors
description: Red, blue and gold. The finest coat in the camp, and hard to wear without being noticed.

name: Egyptian linen
description: Fine white linen with a blue sash, like the clothes Pharaoh gave Joseph.

name: Egyptian headcloth
description: A striped headcloth, for walking in the courts of Egypt.

name: Seven Good Years
description: Store the harvest of seven good years, so that Egypt will have bread in the famine.

name: Miriam's tambourine
description: For singing and dancing on the far side of the sea.

name: Miriam's Song
description: Keep the beat with Miriam and the women on the shore of the sea.

name: Manna Morning
description: Seven mornings in the desert: gather just what your family needs, and trust God for tomorrow.

name: Manna basket
description: For gathering just enough, one morning at a time.

name: Quail
description: One of the little birds that dropped into the camp at twilight.

name: Priest's linen
description: A white linen robe with a blue sash, like the ones the priests wore.

name: Eshcol grapes
description: A cluster of grapes on a pole, as big as the one the spies carried.

name: Ram's horn
description: The sound that brought a wall down.

name: Memorial stone
description: A smooth stone from the middle of the Jordan.

name: Seven Days
description: March to the drum for six days, and shout on the seventh.

name: Ruth's sheaf
description: A bundle of barley, just what you gleaned.

name: Gideon's torch
description: A torch that was hidden in a jar until the right moment.

name: Ram with a fleece
description: Its wool was once wet with dew, and once dry.

name: Gleaning
description: Gather barley behind the harvesters, the way Ruth did.

name: Jars and Torches
description: Break the jars, raise the torches and blow the horns!

name: Samuel's linen robe
description: A little linen robe, like the one Hannah made each year.

name: Horn of oil
description: For anointing a king, if one is ever needed.

name: Saul's crown
description: Heavy on the head. Handle with care.

name: Lost Donkeys
description: Find Kish's six lost donkeys before time runs out.
